title: Deductible Taken on a Corrected TRICARE Select Outpatient Line
content:
**Clause.** On a corrected **TRICARE Select** outpatient line, where the line's service class is in the tier's deductible-exempt service classes or the line is network preventive care, it takes no deductible; where the tier's individual deductible less the deductible already met is less than the amount cost-shared, it takes that remainder, never below zero, rounded to the cent; otherwise it takes the whole amount cost-shared. The deductible already met for a corrected outpatient line is the deductible applied on the enrollment's claim lines less the deductible their reversals withdrew.

## Tier figures

| Tier | Individual deductible (US dollars) | Service classes exempt from the deductible |
|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | 50.00 | preventive care; emergency room visit |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | 150.00 | preventive care; emergency room visit |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | 61.00 | preventive care; emergency room visit |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | 183.00 | preventive care; emergency room visit |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | 150.00 | preventive care |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | 183.00 | preventive care; emergency room visit |

## Judgement

| Line | Individual deductible less deductible already met | Deductible taken |
|---|---|---|
| exempt service class, or network preventive care | any | 0.00 |
| other | less than the amount cost-shared | the remainder, never below zero |
| other | equal to or more than the amount cost-shared | the whole amount cost-shared |

## Hypothetical lines (TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, individual deductible 150.00)

- Deductible already met 110.00 (130.00 applied, 20.00 withdrawn by a reversal), amount cost-shared 300.00: the remainder 40.00 is less than 300.00, so 40.00 is taken.
- Deductible already met 0.00, amount cost-shared 90.00: 150.00 is not less than 90.00, so the whole 90.00 is taken.
- Deductible already met 160.00: the remainder is below zero, so 0.00 is taken.
- An emergency room visit on this tier is not exempt; on TRICARE Select Retiree Group B it takes no deductible.
